copyright_rule: Ideas, procedures, principles and concepts are safe to learn from (17 U.S.C. 102(b)). Never reuse a photo, illustration, body copy, logo, trademark, trade dress, distinctive composition or 1:1 layout. Link + describe; never re-host paywalled screenshots. Record what was intentionally NOT copied.
description: Local, curated, text-only design reference corpus. Principles, tokens and patterns written in our own words from public sources. No scraped screenshots, no paywalled content, no copied layouts, logos, photos or copy.
